record.question: What portal is recently launched by Union Ministry of Tribal Affairs to streamline and expedite the process of releasing scholarship grants directly into bank accounts of beneficiary students?
record.explanation: Answer B: DBT Tribal Web Portal. The Ministry’s direct-benefit scholarship portal is the DBT Tribal Portal (option b). The stem’s word ‘recently’ is anchored to the June 2019 exam. Reference: https://tribal.nic.in/Scholarship.aspx. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
